title: Space intelligences chose Owens for the strongest nervous system since Moses

tellings.quote: He would claim that they discovered he had the most powerful nervous system of anybody they had ever encountered since Moses.

plain: A man named Ted Owens claimed that intelligences from space picked him out because he had the most powerful nervous system of anyone they had met since Moses. The parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove, who knew Owens's claims, relays this as what Owens himself would say. If true, it would mean these beings chose their human contacts for something in their bodies and minds.
